decisions.finding: 300 physical blocks/*.liquid files maximum; 192 VSN elements are conceptual, not necessarily 192 physical files. Sidekick-generated blocks also count.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Explicitly map every conceptual element to block, snippet or reusable section; budget headroom for merchant/AI added blocks.
decisions.check: Measure actual /blocks file count on generated theme; fail above 300; never equate catalog size with compiled count.

decisions.finding: 25 sections per JSON template; 50 reorderable blocks per section; 1250 blocks per template/section group.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Budget rich home/collection/PDP designs inside template and block ceilings; distinguish static from dynamic counts.
decisions.check: Count effective JSON template sections and reorderable blocks before building preset.

decisions.finding: Theme block nesting maximum 8 levels below section.
decisions.vsn_design_action: VSN Group/Container hierarchy must collapse wrappers or use snippets before hitting depth 8.
decisions.check: Walk preset block trees and fail if depth exceeds 8.

decisions.finding: Section-local blocks and reusable theme blocks cannot currently be used together within one section.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Prefer theme-block architecture for globally reusable elements; choose local section blocks only when nesting/reuse is unnecessary.
decisions.check: Static validate section schema does not declare section-local block types alongside @theme.

decisions.finding: Static blocks can be customized/hidden but cannot be reordered or deleted; they do not count toward dynamic max_blocks.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Use static only for essential fixed UI; dynamic merchant components remain reorderable; do not present static as draggable.
decisions.check: QA static/merchant-reorder states and count block caps by correct semantics.

decisions.finding: Theme blocks expose merchant settings and cannot receive parent variables; snippets accept variables but lack editor instance controls.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Reserve theme blocks for merchant-configurable structure; share low-level rendering through snippets to avoid bloated sidebar and file budget.
decisions.check: Architecture mapping specifies per-element compilation type.

decisions.finding: visible_if supports many setting types but cannot evaluate runtime contextual data or resolved dynamic source values.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Separate editor display logic from runtime Liquid conditions for variant, market, customer or metafield values.
decisions.check: No visible_if expression depends on runtime storefront object/value.

decisions.finding: Shopify controls custom CSS at theme/section level; themes must not create, hide or overwrite that native setting.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Expose original token/variation settings, not a fake custom CSS override UI that changes merchant's platform customization.
decisions.check: No duplicated platform CSS settings or writes to platform_customizations.

decisions.finding: Theme settings and blocks can use dynamic sources; merchant setting text translations work differently from Liquid setting values.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Offer metafields/metaobjects where supported; ensure theme locale translations and merchant content translation paths are distinct.
decisions.check: Audit dynamic binding, blank data, markets and locale fallbacks in Stage 8.

decisions.finding: Theme Store themes cannot depend on an app or ship incomplete app-like features; demos can only showcase functionality built into the theme. Mandatory VSN wishlist and comparison powered by a VSN app must not be represented as built-in Theme Store demo features.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Keep Wishlist/Compare requirement in optional VSN apps/extras, but block those app-dependent interactions in Theme Store submission/demo unless Shopify confirms an allowed representation. Retain standard @app integration support.
decisions.check: Theme Store release QA flags app-dependent wishlist/compare demo widgets and any implied native functionality.

decisions.finding: Main product and featured product sections must support @app; product price, description and vendor need granular product blocks.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Theme product layouts must keep independent merchant editability and app-block slots without requiring any app.
decisions.check: Inspect compiled schema on product/featured product and no-app baseline.

decisions.finding: Each Theme Store preset needs at least one matching demo store; theme must be materially unique beyond cosmetic variations. Multi-preset listings require own preset template folders.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Evaluate VSN theme identity across all templates; publish each preset with substantive structural/UX differentiation and a demo equivalent to installed state.
decisions.check: Per-preset demo, listing templates and originality design QA before release.

decisions.finding: Shopify Skeleton is the only approved starting codebase for Theme Store; otherwise code must be fully original, never a Dawn/Horizon-derived submission.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Stage 7 inherits Skeleton/original; competitor and Shopify sample code are research only.
decisions.check: Licensing and source provenance gate at theme development.

decisions.finding: Shopify limits: JSON template and section group 512 KB; settings_schema 512 KB, settings_data 1.5 MB, Liquid code files 256 KB, Liquid setting 50 KB, total zipped theme 50 MB.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Avoid 192-by-nine-breakpoint settings explosion; only expose selected anchors and advanced overrides where practical. Keep content/media outside bloated packaged theme.
decisions.check: CI byte-size/zip-size lint once theme code exists.

decisions.finding: Shopify Theme Store requires average Lighthouse performance >=60 and accessibility >=90 across home, collection, product on desktop and mobile; real content and images are mandatory during testing.
decisions.vsn_design_action: Defer runtime claims until benchmark QA; animate with reduced-motion and avoid oversized nested DOM.
decisions.check: Test six scenarios against benchmark data and browser/touch/keyboard focus.

notes: These are Shopify documented platform constraints and original VSN design implications, not a competitor private Theme Editor inspection.
Do not conflate developer-listed capabilities, open HTML markup and live functional testing.
Current Figma state is no active design; old Afterhours files remain archival.
